## Forms · Create Initial Request → `n8n_createInitialRequest(actor, data, include)`
Runs the **real** `submitInitialRequest` (same emails, same tasks, same sheets). Returns `workflowId` (`NEW_EMP_…`), `formId`, **`internalEmployeeId`** (5-digit, minted at submit), `message` — flattened by the Router.

**Required** (FormContracts r2 `new_hire`): `firstName lastName hireDate(yyyy-MM-dd) requesterEmail reportingManagerName reportingManagerEmail positionTitle siteName(reference.sites) jobSiteNumber(reference.jobNumbers) employmentType(Hourly|Salary) employeeType(Direct Hire|Agency) newHireOrRehire(New Hire|Rehire) systemAccess(Yes|No)`
Other enums: `computerRequestType/phoneRequestType(New|Reassignment|'')`, `computerType(Chromebook|Windows|Mac|'')`, `googleDomain(team-group.com|robinsonsolutions.com|industrialappliedtech.com|stgroup.ca|'')`. `systems[]` ⊂ ADP Supervisor Access, BOSS, CAA, Delivery, Fleetio, Google Account, Incidents, Central Purchasing/Jonas, Net Promoter Score, SiteDocs Supervisor; `equipment[]` ⊂ Business Cards, Computer, Credit Card, Mobile Phone, SiteDocs Tablet, Vehicle. String values may not start with `= + - @` (formula-injection guard).
**Optional inputs exposed here:** `requesterName dateRequested systems[] equipment[] plan306090 jrRequired jrAssignment(reference.jrs) comments`
**Anything else from the optional list** (middleName, googleEmail, computer*, creditCard*, phone*, boss*, jonasJobNumbers, adpSites, department, purchasingSites, adpSalaryAccess, bossTrainingOnly, existingInternalEmployeeId) → put in `extra` as a JSON object. Unknown keys fail with `E_VALIDATION` (fields listed).
`includeRecord:true` adds `record` (header-keyed row from *Initial Requests*).
Contract hash drift: call `n8n_contracts` and compare `forms[].hash` if this ever starts failing.

### Attribution
Pass `actor` from the calling workflow so Forms records who did it, e.g.
`{{ { id: 'n8n:' + $workflow.name, email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: $workflow.name + ' (n8n)' } }}`
If omitted the Router attributes the call to itself. `idempotencyKey` (optional) makes a retry replay the first result for 10 min.
Errors throw as `EFX <CODE>: message` — attach an error output or error workflow on the calling node.
